title: Effective voltage calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the RMS voltage from the given sinusoidal expression, yielding 220 V.

title: Transformer voltage ratio
description: Important: The student must apply the turns ratio to relate the primary and secondary coil voltages (U1/U2 = 4).

title: Transformer current ratio
description: Important: The student must apply the turns ratio to relate the primary and secondary coil currents (I1/I2 = 1/4).

title: Primary loop equation
description: Important: The student must apply Kirchhoff's law to the primary circuit: supply voltage equals voltage drop across R1 plus primary coil voltage (U = I1*R1 + U1).

title: Secondary Ohm's Law
description: Important: The student must apply Ohm's law to the secondary circuit: U2 = I2 * R2.

title: Correct final current I1
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the magnitude of current I1 must be 1 A.

title: Correct final voltage U2
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the magnitude of voltage U2 must be 30 V.

title: Confusing peak with RMS
description: Pitfall: Using the peak voltage (220√2 V) as the effective value in calculations.

title: Inverting transformer ratios
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applying the turns ratio for voltage or current (e.g., U1/U2 = 1/4 or I1/I2 = 4).

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack proper units (V, A) or use incorrect units.
